title: Coach Snapshot QR display fix
details: Share with assessor now loads the QR generator before drawing both single and multipart Coach Snapshots
Small Coach Snapshots no longer fall back to the older v231 single-QR screen
If a single QR cannot be drawn safely, Evia automatically switches to the existing multipart QR sequence
Coach Snapshot contents and privacy rules are unchanged
summary: Evia v233 fixes the blank Share with assessor QR screen by using one reliable current rendering path for both single and multipart Coach Snapshots.
changes: Fixed blank Coach Snapshot QR display
Removed the v231 single-QR rendering fallback
Automatic fallback to multipart QR when needed
No change to Coach Snapshot data
